newsitem.title: FINLAND: FIDELITY TO MARKET ITS FUNDS IN FINLAND - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: FIDELITY TO MARKET ITS FUNDS IN FINLAND - PAPER.

text.p: U.S. mutual fund giant Fidelity Investments will start marketing its funds in Finland in cooperation with local brokerages Evli and Sofi, business daily Kauppalehti reported on Friday.
It said the financial supervision regulator had granted Fidelity marketing permission and quoted Fidelity official Paul Kafka as saying that it would make a serious market entry.
"We are coming to Finland seriously and hope to find many investor contacts through our cooperation partners," it quoted Kafka as saying.
At end-October last year, Fidelity held shares in 16 Finnish companies, the paper said. It said Fidelity is the world's largest mutual fund company with funds worth some $520 billion.
